$comment: Tier-2 differential for the GROUP WARDROBE CRUD (v4 d7263f39
app/api/v1/groups/[id]/wardrobe/route.ts + [itemId]/route.ts), ported to
quilltap-core::api::groups::group_wardrobe_{list,create,get,update,delete}.
One committed file drives BOTH sides:
- the v4 oracle (harness/oracle/cases/group-wardrobe.test.ts, a JEST
oracle in the wardrobe-transfers real-DB idiom) resets to a fresh copy
of the SAME baked wardrobe-transfers fixture pair per case (the group
with its provisioned official store + Wardrobe/ folder + the Household
Livery item already live there), calls the REAL route handlers, and
dumps the seven mount-index tables after each case.
- the Rust family (quilltap-harness group_wardrobe_routes_equivalence)
copies the same fixture pair per case, opens a Db, and calls the
dispatch handlers (v5 serves this family dispatch-only, mirroring the
project-wardrobe precedent — no quilltap-web REST edge).
CASES: list; the 404 'Group' arms on every verb; create (201 with the
{mountPointId, wardrobeItem, wardrobeItems} triple + minted id/ts
normalized by dot-path); the create/update schema 400s (v4's middleware
answers the FLAT {error: 'Validation error'} envelope — the details
array is the standing project-wide deferral); get; get/update/delete on
a missing item (404 'Group wardrobe item'); update (patch + re-read
echo); delete ({success: true}).
NORMALIZATION: per-case `normalize` dot-paths blank the minted values in
the BODY (the transfers family's remap form handles the table dumps), so
every fixture-baked id still compares literally.
SAFETY: testPepperBase64 is the same THROWAWAY key the transfers fixture
bakes. NOT the real Friday pepper; safe to commit.
